overview:
**Fire danger is High today in the Montrose (High Elevation) area, driven by low humidity and dry fuels, with Very High danger expected by Sunday.**
- Trend: danger stays High through Aug 26, then climbs to Very High on Aug 27 as ERC and BI percentiles rise toward the low-90s.
- Weather driver: today's min humidity hit 19%, exceeding the local watchout threshold (1 of 7 watchouts met); afternoon shower/thunderstorm chances (30%) with gusty NE winds.
- No Red Flag Warning is currently posted for this area.
- BLM is reducing fire restrictions from Stage 2 to Stage 1 on public lands, effective Aug. 21 in the Uncompahgre and Gunnison field offices, while San Miguel County is moving into Stage 1 fire restrictions beginning Aug. 21, 2026.
- Nearby incidents: Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is 39,710 acres and 87% contained; Elk Fire in the Grand Mesa/Uncompahgre/Gunnison area is 7,257 acres and 33% contained, both with area/road closures in effect.
